info.title: How does &trento; improve monitoring and validation

abstract.para: Learn about &trento; included in &sles4sap; that helps you monitor and validate &sap; landscape.

topic.para: &trento; automatically discovers servers, &hana; databases, &s4hana; and &netweaver; applications and clusters, validates your setup against &suse; and &sap; best practices, and monitors overall system health. The information can then be accessed through the &trento; Web console.
